checks.name: verbatim_repetition_omission_or_modification_in_output
checks.definition: When emitting the final response string, the agent alters the required verbatim repeated text by omitting required content, substituting words, truncating sentences, or incorrectly including meta-instruction text.
checks.when_to_use: Use when the emitted repeated text fails to match the target verbatim block due to word substitutions, omitted context, truncation, or failure to exclude meta-instruction sentences.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the failure is limited to adding leading quotation marks or wrapper symbols before an otherwise verbatim block.
